title: Chapter 363 Three Heroes
content:
Chapter 363 Three Heroes

"It's me."

Faced with the doubts of the three, Lu Daosheng boldly admitted it.

Although he did nothing, he just stood up and took action on the supreme law.

But without him, the Supreme Law would not do so.

It is hard to imagine that the supreme law that exists in the minds of sentient beings in the Chaos Realm is like a licking dog in Lu Daosheng.

But this is no wonder the supreme law.

Because when Lu Daosheng first entered the Chaos Realm, the Supreme Law had already tried to stop it.

But when he felt a trace of the aura that Lu Daosheng deliberately revealed, he understood and didn't need to pay attention to it.

He just hopes that Lu Daosheng will not be unhappy and will blow up the entire Chaos Realm.

Therefore, these practices of the Supreme Law are naturally understandable.

When the three of them heard Lu Daosheng's confession, they couldn't hide the shock on their faces and looked at Lu Daosheng with an incredible look on their faces.

"Friend, who are you?"

Huo Xingzhi's voice trembled slightly and he asked.

"Am I?"

Lu Daosheng smiled lightly, then turned around, stood with his hands behind his back, and looked faintly at the human land in front of him.

"I am the one who changes the fate of the human race in the Chaos Realm."

Change your destiny!

If an ordinary person says such a sentence, he will inevitably be sneered by everyone.

But this sentence was spit out of Lu Daosheng's mouth, which made people extremely trustworthy.

At this moment, there are already emotionally unstable people in the human race who are overly excited and fainted.

Everyone looked at Lu Daosheng with all the eyes full of fanaticism.

Behind Lu Daosheng, the three of them looked at each other.

An Chang smiled first.

"We can rest assured that the human race in the Chaos Realm has you."

"But you don't hesitate to use the secret technique of blood summoning, which has a huge side effect, and you also want to recall the three of us. I think there must be something we need."

An Chang was quick to think and soon the key to discovering the problem.

With Lu Daosheng's strength, he did not need the help of the three of them at all, and he could also resolve the human crisis.

But the other party activated the blood call.

Could it be that they were deliberately showing off? They believed that such a strong man would definitely not be so boring.

And below, everyone naturally heard An Changzai's words.

They also suddenly reacted.

At first, they thought Lu Daosheng started a blood call to find a helper to protect the human race.

But later they found that Lu Daosheng's strength could actually kill a powerful man in the sky. With such strength, it seemed that he didn't need help.

Could it be that the other party really wants to destroy all the alien races that came to invade?

Faced with everyone's doubts, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "It's natural that there is something wrong to ask you to come back."

"The human race is weak now and needs the support of you seniors."

Upon hearing this, Wu Shang shook his head and said, "Friends, our cultivation is inconsistent with the Chaos Realm and we cannot stay in the Chaos Realm for a long time."

The other two nodded slightly.

"You don't need to worry about this."

Lu Daosheng poked his finger out, and a gentle force suddenly surged out of his fingertips, and then covered the three of them.

The three of them stretched out their hands and looked at them carefully, all of which were amazed.

The three of them cleverly isolated themselves from the Chaos Realm.

In this way, the laws of the Chaos Realm will not be able to restrain them.

The human friends in front of me actually had such a despicable act.

Wu Shang felt incredible and took a light action, and a force shot into the distant void.

There was a bang.

The void exploded, and it was a attack of the Supreme Heaven level.

Obviously, as long as the three of them do not need to produce power higher than this world, they can stay here forever.

"So, thank you."

The three of them bowed to Lu Daosheng again.

Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "I want to thank you."

Logically speaking, the human race in the Chaos Realm has nothing to do, and the three of them should have left. After all, they have their own affairs.

But now, they stayed, so it was naturally for Lu Daosheng's sake.

In this way, the three of them followed Lu Daosheng back to the ancestral land of the human race again.

"We've met three seniors."

In the ancestral land, the vast descendants of the human race saluted respectfully to the three of them.

The three of them looked at the human race at this moment, their eyes extremely complicated.

Once upon a time, their human race was so powerful that they have now fallen to this point.

Although the three of them left the Chaos Realm, they didn't leave for a long time.

To be precise, the three of them are the three heroes who were the last to ascend to the level of cultivation by the human race in the Chaos Realm.

Since the three of them, there has been no such figure in the human race, and it has gradually declined.

"Have you not left any backup plan before you left?"

At this time, Lu Daosheng suddenly asked.

Hearing this, the three of them were slightly stunned. They looked at each other and their faces turned red.

Seeing this scene, even Lu Daosheng couldn't help but twitch the corners of his mouth.

Good guys, you three didn't even stay.

No wonder the human race declined so quickly.

An Changzai coughed lightly, and although his face was awkward, he also said, "Before I left, although the human race was not the strongest, he was also one of the top major races. I didn't expect it to be like this until now, so I didn't leave anything behind. ”

Wu Shang scratched his head, "Before I left, the human race was still fine, so I didn't leave anything."

When he arrived at Huo Xingzhi, this guy had his toes on the ground.

If everyone hadn't looked at him, he whispered: "I, before I left, the human race had just transformed into two supreme heavens, but, I don't think it's a big deal. I have a lot of talents in my human race. I won't be long before I can't wait. Make up the vacancy.”

"Then what?"

An Chang continued to ask.

Huo Xingzhi's voice became even lower, "I, I borrowed two treasures from the clan before leaving."

“…”

For a moment, the entire human race became silent.

Slap!

Wu Shang on the side couldn't help but applaud, "Okay, okay, you guys are playing like this, right?"

Wu Shang smiled and spoke, but his smile was a little cold.

An Changzai's expression was not much better.

The human race looked embarrassed. The human race naturally recorded Huo Xingzhi, a human race hero, and his name was even engraved in the ancestral land.

It can be said to be an existence that has been admired by countless future generations.

They only know that this is a talented and heroic pride of heaven.

But now they learned that this pride of heaven had done such shameless acts.

No wonder, no wonder their human race lacked two treasures, but there was no record.

It turned out that it was "borrowed" by this senior.

"Ahem, that's all over, hahaha, everything is over, now that I'm back, the human race will prosper again!"

Huo Xingzhi waved his hand and then said loudly.

And at this moment, there was another movement from the sky.

Everyone looked up suddenly and saw a beam of light that was ignoring the barriers outside the world and pouring straight into the Chaos Realm.

Everyone was shocked and looked fearful.

The beam slowly dissipated, and a woman in blue clothes and with a superb temperament slowly appeared in front of everyone.
